details: BlackRock is moving to launch two new tokenized money market funds, aiming to navigate yield issues and expand its presence in the digital asset space. This development signals growing institutional interest in leveraging blockchain technology for traditional financial products.
title: BlackRock Files for New Tokenized Money Market Funds on Ethereum

details: Solana (SOL) experienced a significant price surge, breaking above the $90 resistance level. This upward movement led to over $21 million in short liquidations, surpassing Bitcoin's liquidations in the last 24 hours, and is supported by increased ETF inflows.
title: Solana Surges Past $90, Triggering $21M in Short Liquidations

details: Ethereum's price is maintaining support around $2,200, with significant whale buying activity absorbing retail selling pressure. This suggests underlying demand is helping to stabilize ETH despite a slight 2% decline in the past 24 hours, with analysts eyeing a breakout above $2,400.
title: Ethereum Holds $2,200 Support Amid Whale Accumulation

details: Bankers are closely watching as the Senate Banking Committee prepares for a markup session on May 14 for the CLARITY Act, a sweeping piece of legislation aimed at establishing comprehensive crypto regulations. This indicates significant progress toward clearer regulatory frameworks in the U.S.
title: Senate Banking Committee Schedules CLARITY Act Markup for May 14

details: JPMorgan and Mastercard have successfully completed a cross-border transfer of tokenized U.S. Treasuries using the XRP Ledger. This demonstrates the growing utility of XRP in institutional financial plumbing and efficient global settlements.
title: JPMorgan and Mastercard Complete Cross-Border US Treasury Transfer via XRP Ledger

details: The CME Group is reportedly aiming for a June 1 launch of Bitcoin Volatility Futures, pending review by the CFTC. This new financial product could offer investors more tools for hedging and speculation related to Bitcoin's price swings.
title: CME Group Targets June 1 Launch for Bitcoin Volatility Futures

details: LayerZero has issued a public apology and disclosed an RPC poisoning incident, admitting fault in its single-verifier setup, which was linked to the significant $292 million KelpDAO hack. This highlights ongoing security challenges in the DeFi space.
title: LayerZero Discloses RPC Poisoning Incident Linked to $292M KelpDAO Hack

details: Ethereum's share of Total Value Locked (TVL) in Decentralized Finance (DeFi) has fallen to 53%, nearing a multi-year low. This indicates that rival chains are gaining traction and attracting more capital in the competitive DeFi landscape.
title: Ethereum's DeFi TVL Dominance Drops to 53%, Approaching Multi-Year Low
